data.title: Merlin Entertainments Elevates the Guest Experience Across Its Global Attractions with NiCE CXone
data.description: HOBOKEN, N.J.-- NiCE (Nasdaq: NICE) revealed today that Merlin Entertainments, a top player in the entertainment destinations niche, is utilizing NiCE’s CX AI platform, CXone, to enhance guest experiences worldwide. The move covers Merlin's extensive portfolio spanning 140+ attractions in 24 nations, featuring popular brands like LEGOLAND® Resorts, Madame Tussauds, and SEA LIFE, along with various regional thrill parks. By 2025, they are projected to continue expanding their reach.

data.title: LRN Launches Catalyst Policy to Transform Global Corporate Policy Governance
data.description: LRN Corporation, a prominent player in ethics and compliance solutions worldwide, has unveiled Catalyst Policy. This new compliance policy management solution is seamlessly integrated into the LRN Catalyst platform. It empowers organizations to enhance governance practices amidst the evolving landscape of AI-driven governance, risk, and compliance needs. Catalyst Policy streamlines and automates the processes of creating, overseeing, communicating, and implementing policies across various regions, languages, and regulatory frameworks.

data.title: Tickblaze and FPFX Tech Announce Strategic Partnership to Support Modern Prop Firm Operations Across Futures, FX, and CFDs
data.description: In Ottawa, Ontario, Tickblaze has revealed a new B2B partnership with FPFX Tech, a respected tech provider for the proprietary trading domain and the creator of PropAccount.com system utilized by prop firms worldwide. This collaboration integrates Tickblaze into FPFX’s tech ecosystem to cater to prop firms in need of a dependable, contemporary trading platform that complements their existing operational setups on FPFX infrastructure. This move is designed to support prop firms in a more efficient manner by aligning modern trading tools with familiar workflows, providing improved services to the Prop Firms industry.

data.title: Dynamics Square USA Completes Cloud ERP Upgrade for South Carolina Recycling Company
data.description: In Irvine, California, Dynamics Square USA has successfully conducted a Business Central cloud migration for a recycling company based in South Carolina. This migration involved replacing the outdated Dynamics NAV 2018 system that was no longer supported. This transition signifies a significant update in the company's technology infrastructure, ensuring a more efficient and up-to-date system.

data.title: Empowering Communities: ViiV Healthcare Awards $33 Million in Grants to Advance HIV Response in the U.S.
data.description: ViiV Healthcare, a leading HIV company owned by GSK and Shionogi, revealed over $33 million in community grants for the U.S. in 2026. This funding will aid 230 organizations in 110 cities across 36 states and territories, including Puerto Rico. The grants aim to assist populations most affected by HIV, providing crucial support services.

data.title: The LYCRA Company Appoints Hua Du as Chief Executive Officer
data.description: In Wilmington, Delaware, Hua Du has been appointed as the Chief Executive Officer of The LYCRA Company. With a background in leadership, Du aims to drive growth, innovation, and transformation within the apparel industry.

data.title: Viper Partners Represents Dr. Nicholas Sherock and Your Best Kept Secret Aesthetics in Partnership with Spa Medicca
data.description: Viper Partners, an investment banking and M&A advisory firm based in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, recently facilitated a strategic partnership between Dr. Nicholas E. Sherock LLC & Associates, Your Best Kept Secret Aesthetics, and Spa Medicca. Acting as the exclusive financial advisor, Viper Partners successfully brought together the two renowned healthcare and aesthetics businesses from Ohio with Spa Medicca's expanding platform. This collaboration not only merges the expertise of the entities but also injects additional capital and operational resources into the venture.

data.title: Imagine Learning and AIM Institute Collaborate to Advance Research-Informed Literacy Instruction
data.description: In Tempe, Arizona, Imagine Learning has announced a collaboration with the AIM Institute for Learning & Research to support educators in adapting to changing literacy requirements. With states reinforcing literacy standards and schools focusing on implementing effective reading instruction, educators are facing new research, legislative mandates, and higher performance standards for students. This partnership aims to provide guidance as educators navigate these challenges.

data.title: Nirrin Technologies Showcases Next-Generation Bioprocess Analytical Platform and Workflows at BPI Conference and Exhibition
data.description: Nirrin Technologies, based in Billerica, Massachusetts, will be presenting its transformative bioprocessing tools at the upcoming BPI Conference & Exhibition in Boston. The company's Tunable Laser Near-Infrared (TL-NIR) platform will be on display at Booth #831 from September 22 to 25. This platform integrates a shared hardware base with software-driven analytical processes, offering features like the TALOS™ rapid protein quantitation and ATLAS® multi-analyte quantitation. data.title: Survey: 99% of CX Organizations Use Automation, But Only 24% Say It Delivers ‘Very Positive’ Customer Experiences
data.description: A report by CallMiner, a CX automation leader based in Waltham, Massachusetts, in collaboration with Vanson Bourne, highlighted a notable disparity in organizations' capabilities regarding automation deployment and leveraging customer insights for ongoing enhancements. The annual CX Landscape Report unveiled the integration of automation and AI in customer experience strategies as companies strive to handle the increasing volume of interactions efficiently. This indicates a crucial gap in harnessing customer data effectively for improving automation processes.

data.title: Two Powerhouses, One Drive: SharkNinja Joins McLaren Racing as Official Partner
data.description: A partnership has been formed between SharkNinja, Inc. and McLaren Racing, the well-known British motorsport team, covering Formula 1, IndyCar, World Endurance Championship, and F1 Academy. SharkNinja, listed on NYSE as SN, is a leading global product design and tech company. The collaboration makes SharkNinja an Official Partner of McLaren Racing, offering fans exclusive experiences, content, and activations to engage with the team's ethos and innovation.

data.title: Acclaro Appoints Sahil Rishi Group President to Accelerate its Content Intelligence Strategy
data.description: In Boston, Acclaro, a company specializing in content intelligence solutions for effective global communication, has appointed Sahil Rishi as the new Group President. This top executive will report directly to the Board and will lead the company in its enhanced focus on content intelligence. Acclaro aims to leverage AI technology and human proficiency to provide impactful communication strategies. Rishi's immediate appointment signifies the company's dedication to advancing in this field.

data.title: Centauri Health Solutions Acquires Benny the Benefits Navigator, Expands Capabilities
data.description: A health information technology company in Tempe, Arizona, Centauri Health Solutions, has recently acquired Benny the Benefits Navigator (Benny), a technology company based in Iowa. This acquisition aims to bolster Centauri's disability eligibility solution, Member Connect, by incorporating Benny's platform which focuses on simplifying the application process for public benefits, particularly Supplemental Security Income (SSI) and Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI). The deal marks a strategic move to improve efficiency in accessing these benefits for individuals.
